_comment: Recorded nodogsplash identity evidence, used by tests/unit/test_nds_identity.py.
Every string here is byte-shaped like real router output, transcribed from the
sources named in each block — no router was involved in producing this file.
PKG_RELEASE:=2) → apk names it nodogsplash-5.0.2-r2; opkg prints
They are internally consistent (the digest of the fixture's own text) so the
drift and mismatch controls are meaningful; they do NOT hash any real binary.
Capture the real ones on the bench with the TODO(unverified) commands in
lib/nds_identity.py before seeding a qualification manifest.
The sha256 values are sha256('fixture-only:<label>') — real 64-hex digests, distinct per flavour, and deliberately not the digest of any real binary.
